scientific_integrity: A self-contained analytic area formula, strict angular monotonicity and fixed-exponent asymptotic are established. Numerical diagnostics supplement but do not replace the proof. The general radial-minimum identity is acknowledged as elementary. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Concentric equal-scale regions only, fixed 0<p<2, no independent historical priority confirmation, no translations, no uniform p-to-endpoint limits.
title: Exact rotation-overlap rigidity and fractional angular contact for Lamé regions
